scripts.build: npm run build -w @dn/shared && npm run build -w @dn/api && npm run build -w @dn/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @dn/shared && npm run dev -w @dn/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dn/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dn/api && npm run typecheck -w @dn/web
scripts.metrics: npm run build && npm run metrics -w @dn/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @dn/shared && npm run dev -w @dn/web
